summary: Frontend-only regression on the onboarding narrative flow, focused on the founder-requested correction: the 'Votre source d'inspiration' step must show EXACTLY 2 universes (Sagesse & Sens + Univers Foi) — the 'Univers Clarté' card must be gone. Ran two end-to-end runs using fresh magic-link logins (no green Thomas button): (1) Foi flow, (2) Sens flow. All assertions passed and DB persistence was verified.

validation_results.js_errors: 0 critical JS errors (only network 404s for optional preview assets, no 500s)

critical_code_review_comments: SkipLink note on screen 8 still mentions 'l'univers « Clarté » sera appliqué par défaut' — should be updated to reference the new default (Sens/Sagesse) since Clarté no longer exists. Cosmetic copy fix.
Synthesis ternary on line 469 keeps a legacy branch `form.ambiance === 'clarte' ? 'Univers Clarté' : ...` — dead branch now that Clarté was removed; safe to simplify to sens/foi only for clarity.
test_credentials: Magic-link login via ALLOW_GUEST_LOGIN=true; used fresh @example.com emails (see validation_results).
seed_data_creation: Two fresh users created via magic-link, both completed onboarding (foi + sens). Data persisted in /app/backend/zayado.db.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The onboarding step ordering (screen indexes): 4=profil, 5=vision, 6=aha, 7=priorités, 8=ambiance (Inspiration), 9=workspace, 10=synthèse (ob-save), 11=mémoire IA (ob-continue). Sequence to reach ambiance: 4x ob-slide-next → ob-prenom+ob-next → ob-pourquoi+ob-projet+ob-objectif+ob-next (label 'Analyser') → wait ~5s → ob-aha-continue → ob-frein-0+ob-next → ambiance step. Only two ambiance testids exist: ob-ambiance-sens and ob-ambiance-foi (ob-ambiance-clarte removed as expected). Bible link ob-foi-bible-link opens https://thesustain.net/bible in a new tab.
